profile.name: Josiah Johnmark
profile.statement: I build interactive products — games, apps and interfaces — and carry them from the first sketch through to a shipped build.

paragraphs: I have always been interested in making things.

My journey started with more than seven years of traditional pencil art and gradually expanded into photography, digital art, UI/UX and software development. What connects all of it is simple: I like seeing ideas come to life.

I enjoy taking something from imagination to something real — designing it, building it, experimenting with it and refining it along the way. That same process shapes how I learn: I research deeply, explore different approaches, learn through building and improve from every mistake.

Today I am focused on game development and creative technology, combining my background in art, design and development to create interactive experiences. Ludo NX is one example of that approach, bringing those disciplines together in a single project.
about.closing: I am still learning. Still experimenting. Still building.

projects.title: Ludo NX
projects.summary: A mobile board game that rebuilds Ludo as a modern product — gameplay systems, player progression, customisation and an in-game economy, wrapped in a premium board-game look.
projects.role: Game developer · UI/UX designer · Visual designer

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Ludo NX takes a game almost everyone already knows and rebuilds it as a modern mobile product. It brings together game development, UI/UX design, visual design and interactive systems in one project. I designed the interface and visual direction around a clean, premium board-game feel, then built the systems underneath it: gameplay, progression, profiles, rewards, rankings, customisation and in-game interactions.

sections.heading: Concept
sections.body: Rather than treating Ludo as a static digital board, I designed it as a match you enter — distinct player quadrants, clear dice-roll states, and pacing that holds attention from the countdown through to the result screen.

sections.heading: My role
sections.body: Solo, end to end. Product structure, interface layouts, asset creation, C# gameplay programming, 3D key art and audio. Every screen and every system in the game is something I designed and built.

sections.heading: Interface design
sections.body: Designed in Figma and implemented in Unity. The priorities were mobile ergonomics — everything within thumb reach — legible token paths, dice controls that feel physical, and reward moments that land without getting in the way of the next turn.

sections.heading: Gameplay systems
sections.body: A 15×15 board with full turn management, token paths, safe zones and capture logic, dice physics, multiple player setups, and difficulty levels driven by an AI opponent that weighs its options rather than moving at random.

sections.heading: Progression & economy
sections.body: A complete loop around the match itself: profile levels and XP, milestone achievements, unlockable dice and token skins, daily rewards, missions, ranking ladders and an in-game shop.

sections.heading: Visual design
sections.body: A warm, tactile identity — cream and wood board panels against deep navy chrome, gold detailing, custom token silhouettes and short animations that give digital moves a sense of weight.

sections.heading: Engineering
sections.body: Built in Unity on a modular C# architecture with decoupled, event-driven game controllers, optimised sprite atlases and dynamic canvas scaling, so the layout holds from small phones through to tablets.

sections.heading: Result
sections.body: A complete mobile title that shows the full range of what I do: game systems, visual polish, product structure and user experience — all in one build.

projects.title: Selah
projects.summary: A quiet Bible reading and reflection app. Careful typography, unhurried pacing, daily devotionals and verse bookmarking — designed to be calm rather than busy.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Selah is a scripture reading and reflection app built around restraint. The reading view is typographic first — comfortable measure, generous line height, and no competing interface. Daily devotionals, verse bookmarking and distraction-free navigation make up the rest.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.body: Most reading apps fill the screen. Selah takes things off it. Controls stay out of the way until they are needed, the pacing is deliberately slow, and the type does the work.

projects.title: Dakar Dapper
projects.summary: The digital storefront for an editorial menswear and accessories brand curated in Lagos and delivering across Nigeria — catalog browsing, cart and wishlist workflows, and a multi-domain network.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Dakar Dapper is a luxury menswear fashion line curated in Lagos, creating shirts, trousers, footwear, and accessories. I designed and built the digital storefront to reflect the brand's proper, high-fashion identity: warm ivory tones, Cormorant Garamond typography, and intuitive browsing across curated collections.

sections.heading: Multi-domain network
sections.body: The brand operates across three domain properties: dakardapper.com as the primary commercial flagship, alongside dakardapper.org and dakardapper.shop serving as brand and dedicated retail mirrors.

sections.heading: Storefront architecture
sections.body: A fast, responsive storefront featuring an instant search overlay, wishlist persistence, slide-over cart drawer, and direct ordering workflows tailored for Nigerian and international clientele.

projects.title: USH Community
projects.summary: The public platform for a trading community of more than 20,000 members — market insights, education, analysis, mentorship and resources in one place.
projects.role: UI/UX design · Web development · Visual design

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: USH Community is a platform for traders, giving access to market insights, trading education, analysis, mentorship and related resources. I designed and built the website to give the community a clear, professional presence, with a visual direction suited to the trading and financial space.

sections.heading: Focus
sections.body: A straightforward experience that communicates what the platform is for, and makes the key information and community resources easy to reach for its 20,000+ members — responsive from phone through to desktop.

projects.title: Zubairu Mustapha Foundation

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: I designed and built the website for the Zubairu Mustapha Foundation, creating a professional presence for an organisation focused on empowering the boy child. The structure presents the foundation clearly and makes its work easier to find and understand.
